blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Children in Barangay Kasambagan now have access to community-based learning and reading programs following the launch of a Children’s Haven, mobile library, and Bible on Wheels by the Mabolo Police Station of the Cebu City Police Office (CCPO). The initiative was launched at the Vitaliano M. Colina Sports Complex through a partnership among the police station, the Code Red Movement for Christ, the station’s advisory group, barangay officials and community volunteers. The three programs aim to bring educational resources and religious materials closer to children while providing opportunities for community engagement, according to the police station. READ: […]...
